map.广告投放、推广活动等总支出: Total outlay on ad delivery, promotions and similar
map.通过营销获得的新付费客户: New paying customers acquired through marketing
map.可选，计算ROI和回本: Optional, to compute ROI and payback

map.即每次获客成本，指获得一个新付费客户所花费的营销成本。是衡量营销效率最核心的指标: Cost per acquisition is the marketing cost of winning one new paying customer. It is one of the core measures of marketing efficiency.
map.CPA越低，说明营销效率越高；但CPA并非越低越好，需要结合客户价值（LTV）综: A lower CPA means higher marketing efficiency, but lower is not always better: it must be judged together with customer value (LTV).
map.CPA = 营销总花费 ÷ 新增客户数: CPA = total marketing spend / new customers
map.ROI = (客单价 × 毛利率 - CPA) ÷ CPA × 100%: ROI = (average order value × gross margin - CPA) / CPA × 100%
map.回本周期 = CPA ÷ (客单价 × 毛利率): Payback period = CPA / (average order value × gross margin)
map.例如：花费10,000元获得200个客户，CPA = 10,000 ÷ 200: For example spending 10,000 CNY to win 200 customers gives CPA = 10,000 / 200 = ¥50 per customer
map.：仅计算营销渠道获客成本（如广告投放）: : counts only marketing-channel acquisition cost (such as ad delivery)
map.：包含营销+销售的全部获客成本: : covers all acquisition cost, marketing plus sales
map.：每次点击成本，比CPA更上游: : cost per click, one step upstream of CPA
map.：千次展示成本，品牌曝光指标: : cost per thousand impressions, a brand exposure metric
map.LTV : CAC 比值 > 3:1 为健康（3倍以上才划算）: An LTV:CAC ratio above 3:1 is healthy (only 3x or more pays off)
map.回本周期越短越好，通常6-12个月可接受: The shorter the payback period the better; 6-12 months is usually acceptable
map.不同渠道、不同行业CPA差异巨大，需横向对比: CPA varies hugely by channel and industry, so compare horizontally
map.：缩小受众范围，提高目标用户匹配度: : narrow the audience and improve match with the target user
map.：A/B测试广告创意，提高点击率: : A/B test ad creatives to raise click-through rate
map.：优化落地页，降低转化摩擦: : optimize landing pages and remove conversion friction
map.：多渠道搭配，平衡成本与规模: : combine channels to balance cost and scale
map.：准确归因，淘汰低效渠道: : attribute accurately and drop inefficient channels
map.📚 深度解析：CPA 获客成本精算: 📚 In-depth: CPA Acquisition Cost in Detail
map.按总花费和新增客户算 CPA，并拆 CPC。: Compute CPA from total spend and new customers, and break out CPC.
map.用复购率估 LTV，看 LTV:CPA 是否健康。: Estimate LTV from the repurchase rate and check whether LTV:CPA is healthy.
map.总花费 10000、新增客户 200 → CPA=50；点击 5000 → CP: Total spend 10000 with 200 new customers gives CPA = 50; 5000 clicks gives CPC = 2; average order value 300 gives revenue 60000, a 30% gross margin gives gross profit 18000 and net profit 8000, so ROI = 8000/10000 = 80%.
map.复购率 30%、单客利润 150 → 估 LTV≈150/(1−0.3)≈214: With a 30% repurchase rate and 150 profit per customer, estimated LTV ≈ 150/(1−0.3) ≈ 214; LTV:CPA = 214/50 ≈ 4.3:1, above 3 and healthy, so spend can be increased.
map.CPA 多少算健康？: What counts as a healthy CPA?
map.没有绝对值，看 LTV:CPA。比值≥3 可持续，1–3 需优化，<1 亏损。: There is no absolute value; look at LTV:CPA. A ratio ≥ 3 is sustainable, 1-3 needs work and below 1 loses money.
map.净 ROI 和广告 ROI 区别？: How do net ROI and ad ROI differ?
map.本工具毛利已扣货成本，净 ROI 比只看收入的广告 ROI 更接近真实盈利。: This tool already deducts goods cost from gross profit, so net ROI is closer to true profitability than ad ROI, which looks only at revenue.
